title: PESSOA REDATORA SÊNIOR - VAGA AFIRMATIVA
description:
PESSOA REDATORA SÊNIOR ** VAGA AFIRMATIVA EXCLUSIVA PESSOAS NEGRAS, PARDAS e INDÍGENAS**

Área de atuação: Comunicação Interna & Publicidade 


Sobre diversidade

Na DALE, valorizamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo. Acreditamos que diferentes trajetórias geram ideias mais criativas e soluções mais potentes, além de fortalecer um ambiente com repertório sociocultural ampliado. Incentivamos fortemente candidaturas de pessoas negras, pardas, indígenas, mulheres, pessoas LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência e 50+.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa redatora sênior capaz de transitar com fluidez entre comunicação interna e publicidade. Procuramos alguém com repertório jornalístico, domínio de copy e desenvolvimento de conceitos, confortável em atender vários clientes e articular entregas com criação, conteúdo e planejamento.


Objetivo

Ser a referência editorial e estratégica dos clientes da DALE: levantar e refinar briefings, apurar e organizar informações (tom jornalístico), transformar em narrativas claras e persuasivas para públicos internos e externos, garantir consistência de tom de voz e qualidade das entregas de ponta a ponta.


O que você vai fazer (principais responsabilidades)


  • Comunicação interna: comunicados, canais internos, redes sociais corporativas, intranet, campanhas de endomarketing, manuais e guias, newsletters internas, roteiros de vídeo e apresentações.


  • Marketing digital comunicação externa: calendários editoriais, copies para redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.), roteiros, landing pages, e-mail marketing, anúncios (hooks, CTAs) e cases.


  • Conduzir entrevistas e apurações com stakeholders; transformar insumos técnicos em linguagem acessível.


  • Criar conceitos criativos (tanto internos quanto externos), defender racional e garantir aderência à estratégia do cliente.



O que buscamos?

  • Formação em Jornalismo, Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada como pessoa redatora sênior (portfólio com peças de CI e de marketing digital).


  • Português impecável (clareza, coerência, revisão final) e capacidade de adaptação de tom de voz.


  • Vivência em comunicação interna (canais, endomarketing, executivos, cultura).


  • Vivência em social media/marketing digital (copy, funil, SEO básico, UX writing desejável).


  • Organização, senso de prioridade e excelente relacionamento interpessoal com times e clientes.


  • Inglês: intermediário ou avançado (desejável).



Como funciona? 

Local de trabalho: remoto.

Horário: comercial (9h–18h).

Contratação: PJ.

Faixa salarial: R$ 6.000,00.


Benefícios: 

VR R$ 30,00

Plano de Saúde

Plano Odontológico

Seguro de Vida

Totalpass

Licenças estendidas (maternidade 6 meses | paternidade 20 dias) 

Day off de aniversário

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Desenvolvedor de Backend .NET
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Líder global em soluções transacionais , conecta empresas, empregados e comerciantes há mais de 50 anos. Atua em três frentes: Benefícios e Engajamento , Mobilidade e Soluções de Pagamentos e Novos Mercados . Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Pleno para atuar na equipe de Infraestrutura. Buscamos alguém com experiência na função , que tenha vontade de aprender continuamente e trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe .

O projeto envolve o desenvolvimento de uma nova plataforma , composta por APIs, processadores e um portal , utilizando .NET 6 e ReactJS .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar, desenvolver e apoiar na implantação de sistemas e aplicações conforme as tecnologias e padrões definidos.
  • Desenvolver código limpo, organizado e bem testado, alinhado às boas práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Atuar em um ambiente ágil, multidisciplinar e colaborativo.
  • Participar de todas as cerimônias do processo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento de releases até a entrega e implantação das soluções.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com Microserviços , C# , ASP.NET , .NET Architecture e Web Services ;
  • Banco de dados SQL Server ;
  • Conhecimentos em HTML , JavaScript , Docker e Kubernetes .


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com DHTML , Web Design , XSLT , Visual Basic e Crystal Reports ;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com UML , RUP e especificação de casos de uso ;
  • Vivência no setor financeiro será um diferencial.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Python com IA
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência sólida com Python;

- Experiência com Java e Quarkus;

- Conhecimento em JavaScript + Angular;

- Vivência com OCR (processamento e leitura de documentos);

- Uso de Docker para empacotamento e deploy;

- Experiência com AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambdas, S3, Ec2);

- Monitoramento com Grafana;

- Conhecimento de ferramentas de IA aplicadas, como LangChain e Langfuse;

- Fundamentos de IA, NLP (Linguagem Natural), Machine Learning e Deep Learning;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados;

- Vivência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

- Conhecimento em UX conversacional e UI para interfaces com IA.

title: Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors EC Pleno/Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essa vaga é para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors EC PL/SR


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado
  • Prazo: Indeterminado, fazer parte do time da consultoria
  • Atividades: O profissional será responsável atendimento de chamados e melhorias das soluções SAP SF EC, garantindo a aderência às demandas de negócio dos clientes e melhores práticas de mercado. Atuar no suporte AMS do módulo Employee Central (EC) do SAP SuccessFactors. Atender, analisar e resolver chamados/incidentes de usuários. Implementar melhorias e parametrizações no sistema. Realizar troubleshooting em integrações e processos de negócio. Documentar soluções, correções e customizações realizadas. Apoiar na atualização e rollout de releases do SuccessFactors. Orientar e treinar usuários finais sempre que necessário. Interagir com equipes internas e clientes para entendimento das demandas. Garantir aderência dos processos de RH ao padrão SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SuccessFactors – módulo Employee Central (EC).
  • Vivência em atendimento e resolução de chamados AMS.
  • Conhecimento em parametrização, configuração e manutenção do EC.
  • Experiência com integrações do SuccessFactors (Integration Center, APIs, conectores).
  • Conhecimento em processos de RH e estrutura organizacional.
  • Capacidade de elaboração de documentação técnica e funcional.
  • Habilidade para mapeamento de processos e análise de regras de negócio.


Diferencias:

  • Certificação SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.
  • Conhecimento em outros módulos do SuccessFactors (ex: Recruitment, Performance & Goals, Compensation).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou rollout do EC.
  • Atuação prévia em AMS para grandes empresas ou consultorias.
  • Habilidade para realizar apresentações e workshops.


Junte-se a nós e ajude-nos a humanizar o mundo através da tecnologia!

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support founders and leadership teams with daily operations, communication, and project execution. This is a high-trust, high-ownership role where you’ll act as an extension of the founder’s operational capacity, keeping things organized, moving, and aligned. You’ll handle coordination, communication, and light creative work while helping maintain structure across multiple projects and priorities.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage calendars, schedules, reminders, and day-to-day priorities
  • Support internal and external communication on behalf of the founder or leadership team
  • Assist with project management: tracking tasks, organizing workflows, and ensuring deadlines are hit
  • Conduct research and prepare summaries, briefs, and follow-up documentation
  • Provide light design support using Canva (presentations, templates, visuals)
  • Maintain organized systems, files, and SOPs to keep operations smooth and efficient


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Ability to manage multiple moving parts and follow through consistently
  • Proactive mindset, someone who anticipates needs and solves problems before they arise
  • Comfort with light design work (Canva or similar tools)
  • Professional, composed, and able to represent the founder with discretion
  • Bright, resourceful, and adaptable in fast-paced environments

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a QA C# Automation Engineer / SDET to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: US Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Requirements

  • Minimum 10+ years of QA / Testing experience
  • Strong background in testing cloud-native backend platforms, with familiarity in both Azure and AWS environments
  • Hands-on experience with Postman as the primary testing tool
  • Experience in APIs and AWS cloud
  • RestAPI microservice testing experience
  • Experience in writing test automation scripts in C#
  • Experience in testing new API Integration and testing business logic tied to those contracts
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic
  • Experience in QSR industry is a plus
  • Desirable understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry
  • Highly desirable previous experience working for US based clients

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once
  • A positive, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems, and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking, and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative, and help shape a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you!

title: CRO Specialist
description:
Job Type: Remote

Location: Latin America

Availability: Full-time (Mandatory)


Description:

At Elevate Groups USA LLC, we are looking for a conversion architect—not a decorative designer. Your mission: build end-to-end landing pages that are not only visually premium but actually convert. You will be fully responsible for the strategy, design, development, and optimization.


What You’ll Do:

Design and develop landing pages on Shopify with clear conversion-focused narratives.

Implement and analyze A/B tests to optimize performance.

Create premium visual assets using Figma and AI tools.

Optimize page speed, UX, and conversion rates for each page.

Work with full autonomy—from research to deployment.

Essential Requirements


Mindset & Skills:

You think like a direct-response marketer (CRO frameworks, buyer psychology).

You can explain the “why” behind every design choice in terms of conversion.

Portfolio with actual URLs of Shopify pages you personally built.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


Technical Skills:

Advanced Figma (components, prototyping, responsive design).

Shopify (Liquid, advanced CSS, JavaScript, speed optimization).

AI tools (Midjourney/Runway for asset generation).

A/B testing (implementation and analysis).


Nice to Have:

Experience in agencies, freelance, or growth marketing.

Familiarity with premium DTC aesthetics (e.g., Dr. Squatch, HiSmile).

Advanced CSS animations and micro-interactions.

Basic video editing for UGC content.

Experience with Git and theme deployment.

title: Senior Functional Tester
description:
Project Description:

  • The platform is industry-led electronic market trading, data, and analytics solution for loans can be used to grow trading volumes, increase liquidity and remove the cumbersome barriers to entry that have kept many investors from transacting with confidence. The platform is set to modernize and improve existing CLO trading protocols. Recognizing the importance of the asset class and its current market challenges, complete market solution combines electronic execution, advanced data and analytics, and a full suite of connectivity for sell-side and buy-side customers.


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Fidessa Back Office & Middle Office

- Be able to document test cases, execute test cases, and maintain regression test pack

- Needs to determine criticality and raise issues

- Have technical skills working with Genesis Application

- Strong experience in system development lifecycle work

- Test requirements documentation and test plan documentation

- Functional Testing Tools (QTest, Jira)

- Technical skills in JAVA core, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Multi-threading, Concurrency, Performance tuning

- Strong knowledge of SQL (MS SQL Server)

- Must have good communication skills, strong client-facing skills and able to manage client's expectations

title: Senior BackEnd Engineer
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior BackEnd Engineer with a deep understanding of Java programming, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex Java based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.


Technology Requirements

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: Intermediate Full Stack Developer
description:
Intermediate Full Stack Developer

Contract : 3 months + extensions

Rate : USD $13-17/hr

Fully Remote: Brazil - 40 hours/wk


Required Skills:

  • 3-5+ years of professional experience as a full stack developer (excluding internships)
  • Expertise in React.JS and Node.JS, with the ability to right clean code.
  • Comfortable with command line (Mac)
  • Experience with GraphQL and Apollo


Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Familiarity with AWS & Docker
  • Experience with NextJS
  • Familiar with SSR applications and their requirements
  • Experience with Styled Components
  • Experience with ecommerce platforms, e.g. Shopify Plus, CommerceCloud, Hybris, etc.


Job Description:

You use modern tools and frameworks (REACT and Node.js) and can code up an application from scratch and spin up a cloud infrastructure to host it. You have a clear understanding of security and build it into any of your services. Although you have the full support of your teammates, you are able to participate in the research and solution of complex problems. At the same time, you know when to ask for help and don’t let pride or ego get in the way, because after all, you are part of a team. “Initiative” is your middle name, and you don’t give us a chance to chase you. We are on the hunt for people who have an innovative mindset (you still dream of that moonshot project but are currently working on your side-gig)!


Designing and developing user interfaces (UIs): This involves translating design mockups into actual web pages using HTML, CSS, Component Libraries, and React with Typescript.

  • Creating responsive and interactive web pages: Ensuring websites look good and function smoothly on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).
  • Optimizing website performance: Making sure websites load quickly and efficiently.
  • Writing server-side code: Using languages like Javascript, Typescript on Node.js to handle data storage, retrieval, and processing.
  • Developing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces): Creating interfaces that allow different applications to communicate with each other.

title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) / Analytics Engineer


A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) para atuar na construção, organização e otimização de pipelines analíticos, modelos de transformação, governança de dados e camadas de consumo. Essa função combina engenharia, analytics e visão de produto — ideal para profissionais que transitam com fluidez entre dados, negócio e tecnologia.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir pipelines de transformação utilizando DBT com testes, documentação e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines complexos em Airflow.
  • Criar e otimizar estruturas em BigQuery com foco em performance e eficiência de custos.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e análises em Looker Platform, garantindo coerência entre métricas e modelos.
  • Atuar próximo a times de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções analíticas.
  • Garantir organização, padronização e governança das camadas de dados.
  • Automação de processos e validações utilizando Python (quando aplicável).
  • Acompanhar, investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados a dados e pipelines.
  • Documentar processos, modelos e padrões de forma clara e escalável.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a), Engenheiro(a) de BI ou função similar.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, incluindo modelagem relacional e dimensional.
  • Experiência avançada com DBT para construção e gestão de pipelines de transformação.
  • Experiência com Airflow para orquestração de fluxos de dados.
  • GCP – BigQuery : conhecimento profundo de performance, otimização de custos e recursos avançados.
  • Familiaridade com serviços de dados do GCP (ex.: Cloud Storage).
  • Experiência com Looker Platform para criação de dashboards e análises.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis/Consultivos)

  • Perfil consultivo: capacidade de dialogar com áreas não técnicas e traduzir necessidades em soluções.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade para análise de causa-raiz e construção de insights.
  • Cultura forte de documentação, governança e padronização de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises exploratórias.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de negócio (Opcional): AARRR, LTV, CAC, métricas financeiras.


Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, autonomia e alto rigor técnico.
  • Visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias estruturais.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido ou Remoto (ajustável conforme projeto)


Benefícios ATRA

  • TotalPass
  • Reembolso 100% em certificações
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA: Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + Node.js)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: Contract/PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js.
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka.
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend components.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best engineering practices.
  • Deploy, monitor and operate applications in Kubernetes across AWS and/or GCP.
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams on system components and integrations.
  • Participate in code reviews, system design sessions, and operational readiness activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure.
  • Prototype new technologies to improve performance, reduce cost, and increase engineering velocity.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Strong expertise in Java (backend, microservices, distributed systems).
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, offsets, stream processing).
  • Proficiency in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience deploying services on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Practical experience with AWS and/or GCP.
  • Solid understanding of design patterns, system architecture, and microservices.
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL (schema design, performance, migrations).
  • Strong debugging, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in distributed teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with VOD Streaming platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of React for frontend integrations.
  • Exposure to IaC tools: Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, etc.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).

title: Operations Analytics Manager
description:
Job Description:

You will deliver insights using quantitative data to support our operations business. You will work closely with inventory, logistics, retail, and customer services team within the ops org, and partner with tech and finance teams working with nearly all aspects of our growing business. You will collaborate with operations analysts to understand, measure, and optimize efficiency in our operations, provide clarity of business performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive alignment to focus on the most impactful areas for our company.


What You Get To Do Every Day:

Understand and quantify operational efficiency metrics.

Design, implement, and report on item data throughout our receiving, authentication, launch and outbound flow.

Provide key product health measurements and reporting to support the business on a daily basis

Communicate product insights to business partner teams and leadership.


Minimum Requirements:

English - Mandatory

5+ years years analytics experience

Expert in SQL

5+ years of experience with BI tools such as microstrategy, tableau, looker etc.

Expert in translating between practical problems and technical formulations and solutions

Proven ability to design and implement time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, strategic recommendations, and presentation of the findings

Proven track record of thriving with ambiguity


Preferred Requirements:

eCommerce or logistics industry experience preferred

title: Operations Analytics Manager
description:
Job Description:

You will deliver insights using quantitative data to support our operations business. You will work closely with inventory, logistics, retail, and customer services team within the ops org, and partner with tech and finance teams working with nearly all aspects of our growing business. You will collaborate with operations analysts to understand, measure, and optimize efficiency in our operations, provide clarity of business performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive alignment to focus on the most impactful areas for our company.


What You Get To Do Every Day:

Understand and quantify operational efficiency metrics.

Design, implement, and report on item data throughout our receiving, authentication, launch and outbound flow.

Provide key product health measurements and reporting to support the business on a daily basis

Communicate product insights to business partner teams and leadership.


Minimum Requirements:

English - Mandatory

5+ years years analytics experience

Expert in SQL

5+ years of experience with BI tools such as microstrategy, tableau, looker etc.

Expert in translating between practical problems and technical formulations and solutions

Proven ability to design and implement time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, strategic recommendations, and presentation of the findings

Proven track record of thriving with ambiguity

eCommerce or logistics industry experience preferred

title: Designer Pleno
description:
Na Rouz, design é ferramenta de precisão. Buscamos alguém que una estética e clareza para elevar nossos sistemas visuais. Se você tem olhar afiado, domínio técnico e organização, confira abaixo mais informações sobre a vaga.


O que você vai fazer (na prática):


• Produzir materiais estratégicos (e-books, one-pagers, apresentações, diagramas e infográficos claros)

• Garantir identidade e consistência visual (respeito a guias; evolução dos sistemas visuais)

• Preparar arquivos para impressão (sangria, CMYK/PDF-X, aplicação em embalagens)

• Manter organização no fluxo (entregas por tarefas no Notion, nomeação de arquivos, versionamento e prazos)

• Apoiar a criação de moodboards, variações de layout e conceitos exploratórios usando IA

• Otimizar textos curtos (microcopy) e processos de brainstorm com IA generativa

• Criar esboços iniciais de ilustrações/infográficos para acelerar o refinamento técnico


Requisitos (o básico bem feito):


• Capacidade de integrar IA ao fluxo de trabalho para acelerar pesquisa, ideação e organização

• Domínio de Illustrator e Photoshop; Figma para organização e prototipação

• Noção de motion para microanimações (After Effects) — diferencial

• Vivência com print (sangria, verniz/laminação, acabamentos) e relacionamento com fornecedores

• Habilidade para entender conceitos e traduzi-los em layouts estratégicos

• Rigor com prazos, versionamento e atenção a detalhes (tipografia, margens, ortografia, repetição de palavras)

title: US Immigration Consultant
description:
Reporting to: Founders


Company Description


Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform created by immigrants to support the U.S. mobility needs of technologists, artists, and skilled professionals.


Our mission is to streamline the immigration process using innovative tools and resources to empower global talent. Beyond Border is dedicated to fostering inclusivity, bridging gaps, and making global career transitions as seamless as possible.


Our first product is to help tech operators and founders navigate U.S. immigration with ease. We work with Founders and skilled executives to make their U.S. immigration journey seamless.


We are profitable, and are trusted by clients hailing from Microsoft, Google, Meta, Amazon, Klarna, Chime and more.


Role Description

The US Immigration Consultant role is a full cycle sales role from prospecting to closing.


You should have at least 1 year of experience working in US high skilled immigration pathways, including O-1, L-1, EB-1 or EB2-NIW categories.


Legal professionals who have a track record of managing client intakes are welcomed to apply as well.


You will be working with a seasoned operator team that has experience building businesses from Seed to IPO, hailing from Wework, Glints, Square Peg, Apps For Bharat, Solifi and Line Data before.


Qualifications

  • You must have at least 1+ year of US immigration experience, OR
  • You must have managed B2C sales before with a track record of surpassing quota for at least 4 consecutive quarters

title: PPC Analyst
description:
PPC Analyst (Full-Time – Remote from Brazil)


Please make sure to submit your resume in English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be accepted. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Smart Age Solutions is a Digital Marketing agency located in New York with a branch in Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for new talents in Brazil who would like to build a career at an American Company!

Here at Smart Age, we offer a wide range of results-driven services and don’t settle for less-than-optimum quality. Smart Age is the only Google Premier Partner and META Preferred Partner in the jewelry industry. We create precise, fully customizable strategies across Google Search, Social Media, SEO, Retargeting, Display, and Email Marketing to maximize conversions. Our team of industry experts helps businesses succeed in an increasingly digital world by using practices and platforms that deliver results today while planning for what’s coming tomorrow.


Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and results-oriented PPC Analyst to join our Paid Media team. This is a full-time, remote position for professionals based in Brazil.

In this role, you will be responsible for creating, managing, and optimizing Paid Media campaigns across multiple platforms including Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram). You will collaborate closely with our Account Management team to ensure client success through data-driven strategy and precise execution.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a strong analytical mindset, solid communication skills, and a deep understanding of digital advertising platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads for a variety of clients.
  • Manage campaign budgets, bids, and pacing to ensure KPIs and goals are met.
  • Analyze campaign data and performance metrics to generate actionable insights.
  • Produce monthly performance reports and collaborate with Account Managers on strategic recommendations.
  • Monitor trends, updates, and best practices in Paid Media to ensure campaign efficiency.
  • Provide strategic input to improve overall account performance and growth.
  • Ensure tracking and attribution are properly implemented using Google Analytics 4 and/or Google Tag Manager.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Google Ads, including Search, Display, Remarketing, Shopping, and/or Performance Max campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency with data and reporting tools.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) with strong communication skills.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to align digital campaigns with business goals.


Tools You Will Use:

  • Google Ads
  • Facebook Business Manager
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Looker Studio (Google Data Studio)
  • Google Sheets / Excel

Job Details:

  • Type: Full-Time, Remote
  • Location: Brazil-based
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (BRT)
  • Compensation: Based on experience


Join us in shaping the future of global digital innovation! We embrace diversity and inclusion, valuing talent and passion above all else. Don’t miss out on this exciting opportunity to lead strategic marketing initiatives and help expand Smart Age’s reach in the luxury digital space. Apply now and let’s grow together!

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate


Job Type: Full-time, Overnight Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home

Hours: Set Schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


**** This schedule is set and will not change ****


**** Resumes must be submitted in English ****


On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Mindglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $6.60 USD per hour - This amount of hourly pay is only associated with this “overnight” shift as it includes an overnight pay differential.


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil

title: PMO SAP
description:
Descrição da Posição


Estamos em busca de um(a) PMO de Negócio Sênior com sólida experiência em projetos de migração e implementação SAP, especialmente na transição do SAP ECC para o SAP S/4HANA. O profissional atuará no acompanhamento operacional e estratégico das frentes de migração de dados, interfaces e processos funcionais, garantindo comunicação clara, governança efetiva e alinhamento entre negócio e TI.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


Experiência em migrações e implementações SAP ECC → S/4HANA, incluindo:

• Migração de Dados

• Interfaces

• Order to Cash (OTC)

• Source to Pay (S2P)

• PS

• RE / Real Estate (RE-FX)

• Ativo Fixo (AA)

• New GL

• TRM

• Governança e processos corporativos


Competências e Conhecimentos Necessários:

Conhecimento consistente em metodologia PMI

Capacidade de gestão e resolução de conflitos

Excelente comunicação, verbal e escrita

Trabalho em equipe e colaboração multidisciplinar

Experiência com Gestão de Impacto e Mudança (Change Management)

Atuação em Treinamento e Comunicação para equipes de negócio e TI


Escopo de Atividades:

• Realizar o acompanhamento do cronograma, garantindo aderência a prazos e marcos do projeto.

• Conduzir reuniões com todas as áreas envolvidas, documentando atas com atividades, pendências, responsáveis e prazos.

• Monitorar o progresso das atividades junto às áreas usuárias e aos times de TI, assegurando que riscos e impedimentos sejam identificados e tratados.

• Estruturar e manter a comunicação entre os times, garantindo fluxo transparente de informações e alinhamento contínuo entre negócios e tecnologia.


Modelo: 100% Presencial.

Contratação: PJ

O profissional atuará no acompanhamento operacional e estratégico das frentes de migração de dados, interfaces e processos funcionais, garantindo comunicação clara, governança efetiva e alinhamento entre negócio e TI.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


Experiência em migrações e implementações SAP ECC → S/4HANA, incluindo:

• Migração de Dados

• Interfaces

• Order to Cash (OTC)

• Source to Pay (S2P)

• PS

• RE / Real Estate (RE-FX)

• Ativo Fixo (AA)

• New GL

• TRM

• Governança e processos corporativos


Competências e Conhecimentos Necessários:

Conhecimento consistente em metodologia PMI

Capacidade de gestão e resolução de conflitos

Excelente comunicação, verbal e escrita

Trabalho em equipe e colaboração multidisciplinar

Experiência com Gestão de Impacto e Mudança (Change Management)

Atuação em Treinamento e Comunicação para equipes de negócio e TI


Escopo de Atividades:

• Realizar o acompanhamento do cronograma, garantindo aderência a prazos e marcos do projeto.

• Conduzir reuniões com todas as áreas envolvidas, documentando atas com atividades, pendências, responsáveis e prazos.

• Monitorar o progresso das atividades junto às áreas usuárias e aos times de TI, assegurando que riscos e impedimentos sejam identificados e tratados.

• Estruturar e manter a comunicação entre os times, garantindo fluxo transparente de informações e alinhamento contínuo entre negócios e tecnologia.


Modelo: 100% Presencial.

Contratação: PJ

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)

  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)

Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.
